units.source_text: 此后，摄津的表兄又从工作单位给河内的家挂电话，说请我代表参加他姐姐远房亲戚的葬礼。

en.t: After that, Settsu's cousin called the house in Kawachi again from his workplace and asked me to attend the funeral of a distant relative of his older sister on his behalf.

units.source_text: 但是，是谁家的葬礼，村名和墓地，连表兄也一无所知。

en.t: But even my cousin knew nothing about whose funeral it was, the name of the village, or the cemetery.
As we talked, my cousin said jokingly:
